title: 第17章 真传大典 求推荐求月票第18章 筑基 求推荐求月票
content_zh:
时光如水，转瞬五年。
青玄门十年一度的斗法大会，又一次在演武峰热热闹闹地办了起来。
斗法大会结束后第三日，斗法的余热未散尽，宗门便召开了真传大典。
主峰广场上云台高设，法旗猎猎，内外门弟子如潮水般铺开，一层层站满了石阶与观礼台。偶有遁光划过天际，皆在主峰禁制外一折，规规矩矩落到指定区域。
出席真传大典，是宗门明令的强制任务，一来当众册立新晋真传，定下名分；二来也借此凝聚人心，激励众多低阶弟子，只要肯吃苦、肯拼命、肯为宗门做贡献，便有望登上真传之列。
二三十位筑基长老三三两两地在高台上交谈，连说话声都压得极低。
楚无忌站在真传弟子队列里，一副平平无奇古天乐模样。他面容刚毅沉稳，身材高大，衣袍朴素，神色一如既往地平静。
这种场面，对于楚无忌而已，已算不得什么。
自从他五年前获得预备真传名分后，相当于预定一枚筑基丹名额，只待真传大典前宗门以饲养的大青鱼妖核开炉炼丹，大典一过，筑基丹便能落到他手里。
正常情况下，五级妖兽才能拥有内丹，不过大青鱼天赋异凛，在二级妖兽时就能凝聚可称为内丹雏形的妖核，其妖核可以被用来炼制筑基丹。
也正因为提前预订筑基丹名额，明里暗里的各种试探以及大场面，他见得不少。
可他主打一个苟字，未筑基前绝不轻易离宗门半步。而他又有内门身份，可自行接取任务，不必像外门弟子一样，被长老们随手派去做强制任务。
他这些年只接丹峰的炼丹任务，既能稳稳攒贡献，又无需外出涉险，省去许多变数。
遥想当年，楚无忌还只是台下一个不起眼的小角色，站在人群里如同喽啰一般，只能远远瞧见真传身影，也曾在此处仰望真传峰上一座座洞府开启聚灵阵的灵光。
而今日，他也终于站上台了。
真传大比的百艺十席，往年多半被各个峰头势力瓜分，少有人能凭一己之力硬闯进去。
可楚无忌偏偏做到了。
靠的不是筑基级炼丹师，而是创法。
五年前，他上交的那套科学炼丹秘法，经丹峰诸多炼丹师反复推演、校验、改良，早已不再是某个人的奇技淫巧，而是一系列的可复验、可推广的炼丹法门：火候分段、时间曲线、节点操作等等，写得清清楚楚。甚至连练气级丹师都能依法复现，稳定炼出部分筑基级丹药。
于是前几日斗法大会期间，宗门正式把百艺创法一席给他，名正言顺。

这时，一道温和声音从旁传来。
“楚师弟。”
楚无忌转头，只见一名青年修士缓步而来，眉目清秀，气息沉稳。其腰间挂着藏经阁值守的令牌，正是方源。
“方师兄。”楚无忌拱手。
方源笑了笑，语气里带着几分感慨：“五年前你那门秘法入藏经阁时，我还以为只是奇巧一时。没想到这几年查阅的人越来越多，贡献点的流水都快赶上几门老牌筑基功法了。你那份分成，想必也攒了不少吧？？”
楚无忌只淡淡一笑：“勉强够用。”
他没有多说。
修仙界里，财不露白是常识，尤其是他这种动别人饭碗的，更没必要把腰包亮出来。
两人说话间，人群又起了一阵细微骚动。
另一侧有人大步走来，衣袍华贵却不浮夸，领口暗纹精致。此人一出现，附近不少弟子便下意识让开半步。
蔡昆。
十余年前那场宴会的主事者，如今和方源一样，是长老会推举的真传之一。
“楚师弟。”蔡昆先是一礼，笑容得体，“当年一宴，不过一时兴起，没想到楚师弟真能走到今日，恭喜。”
他顿了顿，又似随口一叹：“想当年我还与你把酒言欢，说创法何其艰难，练气修士断不可能创法。如今看来，我那时倒像个笑话。师弟当时心里，怕是早在笑我了吧。”
楚无忌也拱手，语气不卑不亢：“蔡师兄言重了。”
蔡昆又道：“师弟能从百艺里杀出来，比斗法台上赢几场更难。”
这话倒不假。斗法台上胜负分明，输了便退；百艺评定却涉及峰头利益、长老脸面、宗门供给，牵扯更多。
content_en:
Time is like water, and five years have passed in a blink of an eye.
The Qingxuan Sect's ten-year martial arts competition was once again held lively at Yanwu Peak.
On the third day after the fighting ceremony, before the remaining heat of the fighting had dissipated, the sect held the True Inheritance Ceremony.
On the main peak square, a high cloud platform was set up, with Dharma flags and disciples spread out like a tide, and the stone steps and viewing platforms were filled up layer by layer. Occasionally, there are escaping lights across the sky, which all bend outside the restriction of the main peak and fall neatly into the designated area.
Attending the True Succession Ceremony is a compulsory task expressly ordered by the sect. Firstly, the new True Successor is publicly registered and his or her title is determined. Secondly, it is also used to gather people's hearts and inspire many low-level disciples. As long as they are willing to endure hardship, work hard, and contribute to the sect, they are expected to be among the true successors.
Twenty or thirty foundation-building elders were talking in twos and threes on the high platform, and even their voices were kept extremely low.
Chu Wuji stood in the queue of true disciples, looking like an ordinary Gu Tianle. His face was resolute and steady, he was tall, his clothes were simple, and his expression was as calm as ever.
This kind of scene was nothing to Chu Wuji.
Since he obtained the status of Preparatory True Succession five years ago, it was equivalent to booking a place for a Foundation Establishment Pill. He only had to wait for the sect to refine the elixir with the big herring demon core raised by the sect before the True Succession Ceremony. Once the ceremony was over, the Foundation Establishment Pill would fall into his hands.
Under normal circumstances, only level five monsters can possess inner elixirs, but Big Blue Fish has extraordinary talent. As a level two monster, it can condense a demon core that can be called the prototype of an inner elixir. Its demon core can be used to refine foundation-building elixirs.
Precisely because he had reserved the Foundation Establishment Pill quota in advance, he had seen a lot of overt and covert temptations and big scenes.
But his main character is "gou", and he will never leave the sect easily before establishing the foundation. And since he has an inner sect status, he can take on tasks on his own. He does not have to be randomly assigned by the elders to do mandatory tasks like outer sect disciples.
In recent years, he has only taken on Danfeng's alchemy tasks, which allows him to steadily accumulate contributions without having to go out to take risks, eliminating many variables.
Thinking back to those days, Chu Wuji was just an inconspicuous little character in the audience. He stood in the crowd like a gangster and could only see the true figure from a distance. He also looked up at the aura of the spiritual gathering arrays opening up in the caves on the True Legend Peak here.
And today, he finally stood on stage.
In previous years, most of the ten seats in the True Inheritance Competition were divided among various peak forces, and few people could break into it on their own.
But Chu Wuji just did it.
What he relies on is not the foundation-building alchemy master, but the creation of magic.
The set of scientific alchemy secrets that he handed in five years ago has been repeatedly deduced, verified and improved by many alchemists in Alchemy Peak. It is no longer a unique skill of one person, but a series of alchemy methods that can be retested and promoted: fire segmentation, time curve, node operation, etc., all written clearly. Even Qi-level alchemy masters can reproduce according to the law and stably refine some foundation-level elixirs.
So during the fighting competition a few days ago, the sect officially gave him a seat at Baiyi Chuangfa, which was justifiable.
At this time, a gentle voice came from the side.
"Junior Brother Chu."
Chu Wuji turned his head and saw a young monk walking slowly towards him, with delicate features and a calm aura. Hanging on his waist was the guard badge of the Sutra Pavilion, it was Fang Yuan.
"Senior Brother Fang." Chu Wuji held his hand.
Fang Yuan smiled, with a bit of emotion in his tone: "When your secret method entered the Scripture Pavilion five years ago, I thought it was just a temporary coincidence. Unexpectedly, more and more people have checked it out in the past few years, and the flow of contribution points has almost caught up with several old foundation-building techniques. You must have saved a lot of your share of the share, right??"
Chu Wuji only smiled faintly: "Barely enough."
He didn't say much.
In the world of immortality, it is common sense not to reveal your wealth, especially for people like him who try to steal other people's jobs. There is no need to show off your pockets.
While the two were talking, there was another slight commotion in the crowd.
Someone was striding over from the other side. His robes were luxurious but not exaggerated, and his collar had delicate dark patterns. As soon as this person comes outNow, many disciples nearby subconsciously gave way.
Cai Kun.
The person in charge of that banquet more than ten years ago is now one of the true successors recommended by the Presbyterian Church, just like Fang Yuan.
"Junior Brother Chu." Cai Kun bowed first and smiled appropriately, "The banquet back then was just a whim. I didn't expect that Junior Brother Chu would actually make it this far. Congratulations."
He paused, then seemed to sigh casually: "Back then, I was chatting with you over wine, saying how difficult it was to create a method, and that it would be impossible for a Qi-training monk to create a method. Now it seems that I looked like a joke at that time. Junior brother, I was probably laughing at me at that time."
Chu Wuji also handed over his hand, and his tone was neither humble nor arrogant: "Senior Brother Cai's words are serious."
Cai Kun added: "It's more difficult for junior brother to fight his way out of Baiyi than to win a few games on the fighting stage."
This is true. On the fighting stage, there is a clear winner, and if you lose, you will retreat; but the evaluation of Baiyi involves the interests of the peak, the face of the elders, and the supply of the sect, which involves more.
